faq: No one honestly can. We improve clarity and remove friction using proven store practices, and set up tracking so you can measure the change over the following weeks.
Can you change the BigCommerce checkout?
Yes, within what BigCommerce allows. We can reorder and simplify fields, and change checkout text and styling. Deeper changes depend on your plan, and we say so before we start.
The Premium package includes a test plan you can run with a testing tool of your choice. Running long tests is outside a seven day project, so we set them up rather than run them.
Will you need my analytics access?
It helps. Read access to your analytics lets us pick the pages that matter most. If you have none, we start with your best sellers and add basic tracking.
